svg.title: Ember and Iron — Legacy talent tree
svg.desc: Twenty-four permanent talents in four independent sequential chains: Force, Artifice, Commerce and Lore. Each talent has one rank and requires the previous talent in its branch. Costs by depth are one, one, two, two, three and four Legacy points. The first talent requires one completed retirement.

text.tspan: A master retires. Their craft remains.
Legacy tree · 24 permanent talents · four independent paths · one rank per talent
First node: complete one retirement. Later nodes: own the previous node in that branch.
Spend across any branch. Costs by depth: 1 → 1 → 2 → 2 → 3 → 4 points; 13 points completes one branch.
Production capacity and the strength of the forge
Fine workmanship, magic and the chosen heirloom
A lasting reputation and an efficient business
Faster learning, richer returns and stronger parties
Eligible at smith level 8 and 6 quest wins. Retirement is optional and requires a reset preview.
Points earned = 1 + floor(level / 5) + floor(quest wins / 5) + floor(masterworks / 3).
Keep purchased Legacy talents, collection records, decor, and one physical heirloom plus its recipe.
Reset run progress, heroes, stats, stations and gold; retained collection records do not unlock every recipe.
Arrows are prerequisites, not exclusive choices. Sparks are Legacy points. Permanent effects apply to later generations. Full design · v0.5
